title: On Some Faraway Beach
feel: Slow, building, piano-led, about 70 bpm (estimate); whole-note strums or slow arpeggio

sections.name: Third phrase
sections.bars: C | G | F | A | D G

why: **Modal mixture**: ♭VII (F) next to V (D) and V/V (A) in one loop — hear Mixolydian against major.
hard_change: **F barre → A → D** in consecutive bars.
theory: IV–I–♭VII–V–I in G; the A is V/V.
steps: Changes alone, slowly: F → A → D → G.
With the rhythm at 70% (about 50 bpm), whole-note strums.
caveat: A piano song reduced for guitar; two simple fan charts agree — voicings are yours to choose.
